urlField.label: Link
urlField.placeholder: Paste a link from YouTube or any supported site

combobox.more: {{n}} more: keep typing to narrow it down.

bot_check.title: YouTube wants to confirm you're not a bot
bot_check.action: Turn on your browser cookies in Settings → Accounts, then try again.

age_restricted.title: Age-restricted video
age_restricted.action: Sign in to an adult account in your browser and turn on its cookies in Settings → Accounts.

login_required.title: This content requires signing in
login_required.action: Turn on your browser cookies or add your site account in Settings → Accounts.

private.title: The video is private
private.action: If your account has access, turn on your browser cookies in Settings → Accounts and retry.

unavailable.title: The video is no longer available
unavailable.action: It may have been removed or blocked. Open the link in your browser to confirm.

geoblocked.title: Not available in your country
geoblocked.action: The uploader restricted it by region. Try from a connection in an allowed region.

ffmpeg_missing.title: ffmpeg is missing
ffmpeg_missing.action: Install it with one click in Dependencies; it joins video and audio.

js_runtime_missing.title: The JavaScript runtime (Node.js) is missing
js_runtime_missing.action: Install Node.js in Dependencies; YouTube requires it to list formats.

unsupported_url.title: This link isn't supported
unsupported_url.action: Check that it points to a video or a playlist. If the site is new, update yt-dlp in Dependencies.

network.title: The connection dropped
network.action: Check your internet connection and try again.

cookies_locked.title: The browser is locking its cookies
cookies_locked.action: Quit the browser completely and retry. With Brave, Chrome or Edge, use the ymd extension in Settings → Accounts.

cookies_decrypt.title: Couldn't read the browser's cookies
cookies_decrypt.action: Quit the browser and retry. With Brave, Chrome or Edge, use the ymd extension in Settings → Accounts.

disk_full.title: The disk is full
disk_full.action: Free up space or choose another destination folder in Settings → Downloads.

permission_denied.title: No permission to write to the folder
permission_denied.action: Choose another destination folder in Settings → Downloads.

binary_missing.title: A required tool is missing
binary_missing.action: Open Dependencies and install whatever is marked as missing.

unknown.title: The download failed for an unexpected reason
unknown.action: Retry. If it fails again, update yt-dlp in Dependencies and copy the technical detail if you need to report it.

accent.label: Accent color
accent.adjusted: We adjusted the shade so it stays readable.
accent.invalid: Use a color like #rrggbb, for example #5b3fc4.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.paste: Paste a link and check it (with the counter empty)

toast.appUpdate: A new version of ymd is available: {{version}}
toast.appUpdateNotifyBody: Open ymd to see what’s new and install it in one click.
toast.hiddenToTray: ymd is still in the system tray. Quit it from its icon or change this in Settings → Advanced.
toast.hiddenToTrayMac: ymd is still in the menu bar. Quit it from its icon or change this in Settings → Advanced.
toast.jobsMixedBody: Open ymd to see what failed in the Ledger.

clip.title: Section
clip.hint: Leave empty to download the whole video. Type seconds, m:ss or h:mm:ss, for example 1:30.

options.title: Options for this download
options.hint: Only for protected videos. Not saved: used for this download and then forgotten.

picker.label: Playlist entries
picker.shiftHint: Shift + click marks every entry between two clicks.
picker.noneWarn: Pick at least one entry to file the playlist.

browser.suggest: Use the {{provider}} link sent from the browser?

batch.label: Several links
batch.invalidNote_one: {{count}} pasted item is not a downloadable link and is left out.
batch.invalidNote_other: {{count}} pasted items are not downloadable links and are left out.
batch.overflowNote_one: {{count}} more link is left out: the limit is {{max}} at a time.
batch.overflowNote_other: {{count}} more links are left out: the limit is {{max}} at a time.
batch.askOnce: Asked once for all of them
batch.wholePlaylistsHint: When off, a playlist link downloads only the linked video.

empty.title: The ledger is empty
empty.body: Paste a link at the counter, pick Video or Audio and press File it. Every download gets a number and shows up here with its exact progress.
empty.paste: pastes and checks a link from anywhere on this screen.

ledger.actionFailed: The action could not be completed

queue.description: Every download in this session, newest first.

schedule.invalid: Enter a valid time, such as 23:30.
schedule.body: Queued downloads wait until then; running ones carry on. Quitting ymd forgets the time.

pending.body: They were halfway through when ymd closed. Resumed, they pick up where they left off.
pending.secretTitle_one: {{count}} download needs its password or code
pending.secretTitle_other: {{count}} downloads need their password or code
pending.secretBody: Paste them again in Receive: they need the password or the code.

catalog.description: Everything ymd has archived. Search by title, link, path or accession number.

empty.title: The catalog is empty
empty.body: Every archived download is noted here with its date, size and location, so you can find it later.

noResults.title: No results
noResults.body: Try another word or clear the type filter.

confirm.title: Empty the catalog?
confirm.body: All catalog entries are deleted. Downloaded files stay in your folders.

deps.description: ymd installs these tools in your user folder, checks their signature when the author publishes one, and keeps them up to date.
deps.manual: Install it with your system package manager:
deps.failedHint: The previous copy, if any, is untouched. Check your connection and retry.
deps.allFailedHint: What was already installed is kept. If GitHub rate-limited the downloads, wait a few minutes and retry.
deps.ytdlpLocked: yt-dlp can't be changed while downloads are running or queued ({{n}}). Wait for them to finish or cancel them.

desc.ffmpeg: Merges video and audio and converts formats.
desc.node: JavaScript runtime (Node.js) YouTube requires to hand out formats.
desc.aria2c: Downloads over several connections at once.
desc.atomicparsley: Embeds cover art in MP4 and M4A files.

runtime.title: JavaScript runtime
runtime.why: YouTube requires running JavaScript to hand out formats; yt-dlp uses the first one in this list.
runtime.noneBody: Without one, YouTube may refuse video formats. Install Node.js in one click.

binDir.title: Tools folder
binDir.hint: The programs live here, outside ymd's install; removing them doesn't touch your downloads.

deps.systemOutdated: The system {{name}} ({{version}}) is out of date. ymd can install its own copy, which takes precedence; the system file is left untouched.

onboarding.title: Before the first accession
onboarding.lead: ymd downloads with yt-dlp and merges video and audio with ffmpeg. They are installed once, verified, in your user folder.

tools.title: Tools
tools.body: What downloading requires, plus Node.js if your computer has no JavaScript runtime.
tools.failedHint: Usually the connection or a temporary GitHub limit. What's installed is kept; retry in a moment.
tools.where: You can review, update or remove them any time in Dependencies.

folders.title: Where things are filed
folders.body: Videos and music go to separate folders. Each preset can have its own.

accounts.title: Accounts (optional)
accounts.body: If YouTube asks you to confirm you're not a bot, ymd can use your browser's cookies.

onboarding.readyNote: Paste your first link at the counter.
onboarding.notReadyNote: Without yt-dlp and ffmpeg nothing can be downloaded; you can install them later in Dependencies.

downloads.askEachTime: Ask for the folder on every download
downloads.templateHint: Use yt-dlp fields such as %(title)s, %(id)s, %(uploader)s or %(ext)s.
downloads.templateExt: Include %(ext)s so the file keeps its extension.
downloads.concurrencyHint: Between 1 and 8. More at once share the same connection.
downloads.archiveHint: yt-dlp notes every video in an archive file and never repeats it.
downloads.aria2cHint: Downloads each file over several connections.
downloads.aria2cMissing: Install aria2c in Dependencies to turn this on.
downloads.limitRateHint: Applies to downloads that start from now on.
downloads.limitRateInvalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and 1000.
downloads.notify: Notify me when a download ends
downloads.notifyHint: Only while ymd is in the background. Downloads that end together arrive as one notification.

clipboardHint.off: ymd doesn't look at the clipboard.
clipboardHint.known: A link from YouTube, Vimeo, SoundCloud or another known video or audio site is pasted for you when the counter is empty.
clipboardHint.any: Known sites are pasted for you; any other link is suggested and waits for you to accept it.

downloads.clipboardPrivacy: ymd reads the clipboard only when you return to the window, ignores anything that isn't a link and never saves it.

presets.description: A preset sets the format, quality and what gets embedded. Built-in ones keep their format; duplicate them to make your own.
presets.builtinLocked: On a built-in preset only the embedding options and the folder change; the format stays current with ymd.
presets.name: Name
presets.sponsorblockHint: yt-dlp cuts the community-marked segments out of the file.
presets.splitArtistTitleHint: If the video title reads “Artist - Song”, each part goes into its own tag.
presets.squareCoverHint: Crops the thumbnail around its center so it is square.
presets.normalizeVolumeHint: Brings the volume to a standard level (-14 LUFS).
presets.normalizeVolumeNeedsReencode: Not available with the Original format, which does not convert the audio.
presets.outputDirDefault: Empty: uses the video or music folder.

channelHint.stable: Tested releases. They can take weeks to catch up with site changes.
channelHint.nightly: Recommended: a daily build with the latest fixes.
channelHint.master: Every change as soon as it lands. Only if you're after a specific fix.

advanced.autoUpdateHint: Checks when ymd opens and updates when nothing is downloading.

diagnostics.hint: A file to attach to an issue. It doesn't include cookies, passwords or your history.

tray.title: When closing the window
tray.keep: Keep ymd in the system tray
tray.keepMac: Keep ymd in the menu bar
tray.hint: When you click the X, ymd hides next to the clock: downloads keep going and it answers «Download with ymd» instantly. To close it, use «Quit» in its icon.
tray.hintMac: When you click the X, ymd hides in the menu bar: downloads keep going and it answers «Download with ymd» instantly. To close it, use «Quit» in its icon.
tray.off: Clicking the X quits ymd completely.

app.title: ymd
app.hint: ymd updates are signed, come from GitHub Releases and are verified before installing.
app.dev: Updates only work in the installed app.
app.noReleases: No ymd versions have been published yet. The first one will show up here.
app.offline: Couldn’t reach GitHub. Check your connection and try again.
app.failedHint: Try again later. If it keeps failing, download the latest version from ymd’s releases page on GitHub.

extension.title: ymd extension for Chromium browsers
extension.lead: The extension sends ymd the cookies of the sites you choose whenever they change. It works with the browser open and without exporting files.

status.connected: ymd receives {{browser}}'s cookies with nothing else to do.
status.pending: The bridge is ready. Install the extension with the steps below; the first sync will arrive on its own.
status.noBridge: ymd hasn't registered with your browsers yet. Restart ymd to register it; if nothing changes, reinstall ymd.
status.unavailable: Couldn't check the extension status. ymd tries again every few seconds.

extension.step1: Show the extension folder that ships with ymd: it's the one you'll drag.
extension.step2: Open {{browser}} and go to its extensions page:
extension.step3: Turn on “Developer mode”. Then drag the folder from step 1 onto the page, or press “Load unpacked” and choose it.
extension.step4: A welcome page opens: pin the extension to the toolbar. YouTube is already added, so just sign in to YouTube in that browser and ymd will receive the cookies on its own. Other sites are added from the extension.
extension.noFolder: This build doesn't include the extension folder (development mode).
extension.openFailedHint: Open {{browser}} and type {{url}} in the address bar.
extension.idHint: To check on the extensions page that it's ymd's.
extension.syncedBody: The cookie source changed to “Extension” and keeps itself up to date.
extension.openedCopied: We copied {{url}}: paste it into the address bar (Ctrl+V) and press Enter. Browsers don’t let other programs open that page directly.
extension.openedType: Type {{url}} into the address bar and press Enter. Browsers don’t let other programs open that page directly.
extension.folderFailedHint: Open it from your file manager at this path:
extension.firefoxDefaultBody: ymd reads Firefox cookies directly, so you don’t need the extension. Sign in to YouTube in Firefox and use its cookies.
extension.outdated: A new version of the extension is available ({{version}}). Open {{browser}} → extensions and click reload on ymd Cookies.

cookies.title: Browser cookies
cookies.description: Some videos only download while you're signed in. Choose where ymd gets your cookies from.

hint.none: ymd downloads as if you weren't signed in. Use it for public videos or when you'd rather not use your account.
hint.extension: For Brave, Chrome, Edge and other Chromium browsers: the ymd extension sends your cookies whenever they change.
hint.browser: ymd reads Firefox's cookies on every download, even while it's open.
hint.browserMac: ymd reads Firefox's or Safari's cookies on every download.

accounts.testOkBody: ymd could read them. They'll be used for the next downloads.

file.title: ymd's cookie copy
file.noneYet: No copy yet. The ymd extension creates it when it syncs.
file.privacy: The copy holds your browser's cookies, that is, your signed-in sessions. It's stored only in your user folder, readable only by you, and deleted in one click.

sites.title: Site accounts
sites.description: For sites that ask for a username and password, such as Vimeo.
sites.siteHint: Search the site by name. Only sites that support signing in are listed.
sites.keychain: Passwords go to the system keychain and are used without touching the disk or the command line. ymd never shows them again.
sites.otherDesc: Type the site key yourself if it isn't on the list.
sites.keyHint: The site's netrc key, for example vimeo.
sites.keyInvalid: Use only lowercase letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore, not starting with a hyphen or underscore.
sites.youtubeTitle: YouTube doesn't accept a username and password
sites.youtubeBody: For YouTube, use the cookies section above.

supported.title: Supported sites
supported.description: The official list from yt-dlp, ymd's download engine. Bundled with ymd and updated with each release.
supported.empty: No site matches. If yours isn't here, see “How do I add more?”.

howto.title: How do I add more?
howto.accountTitle: The site asks for an account
howto.accountBody: Pick it in “Site accounts” and save your username and password. ymd uses them when you download from that site.
howto.cookiesTitle: The site has no account or needs a browser login
howto.cookiesBody: Use cookies: sign in with your browser and ymd uses that session.
howto.genericTitle: The site isn't on the list
howto.genericBody: Paste the link anyway: ymd works with many pages that aren't on the list. If it fails, you can ask yt-dlp, the download engine, for support.

session.notAddedHint: The extension does not send YouTube yet. Open it in {{browser}} and add YouTube from “Suggested sites”.
session.closedHint: The copy doesn't hold your YouTube session. Sign in to YouTube in {{browser}} and ymd will get it on its own.
